question: Should OpenClaw expose `referenceContext` and `reference-context` as public plugin SDK surface now, mark the lane experimental first, or keep only an internal Codex projection until the cross-host contract is designed?
rationale: The code path is plausible, but the public SDK and prompt-authority semantics require maintainer product and security intent that an external contributor PR cannot establish on its own.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this PR now, keep the linked issue as the canonical design thread, and invite a maintainer-sponsored PR when the API direction is chosen.

options.title: Sponsor experimental lane
options.body: Ask the contributor to make the lane explicitly experimental in docs/API wording and merge it only with maintainer ownership of upgrade expectations.

options.title: Sponsor stable lane
options.body: Accept the new public SDK contract as stable after final maintainer review of compatibility and security semantics.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR now, keep the linked issue as the canonical design thread, and invite a maintainer-sponsored PR when the API direction is chosen.

likelyOwner.reason: The central unresolved choice is the context-engine public contract, and history points most strongly to jalehman on that API surface.
